mode_of_action.summary: Gibberellin A3 (GA3) is a diterpenoid plant growth regulator acting through the GA signaling pathway: GA binding triggers degradation of DELLA repressor proteins (e.g., FveRGA1 in strawberry), releasing growth-promoting transcription programs; it induces expression of GA-biosynthesis genes (GA20ox) and promotes cell elongation, runner/stolon outgrowth, flowering-related processes and fruit set/parthenocarpy via crosstalk with auxin and cytokinin.

strawberry.gap: Runner-production mechanism (GA3 -> runners; DELLA/GA20ox pathway; photoperiod trade-off) is well verified by 4 abstracts. CSV dosage specifics (25-200 ppm foliar; 100 mg/L 'best for vegetative results'; 1.0 mM weekly -> ~13 runners; 200 mg/L + long photoperiod -> flower abortion/malformed fruits; 0.5 mM citric buffer/DMSO fruit application) could NOT be corroborated in PubMed/OpenAlex and remain unverified/inferred. Classic OpenAlex hits (Thompson & Guttridge 1959 Nature 10.1038/184072a0b - 'Effect of Gibberellic Acid on the Initiation of Flowers and Runners in the Strawberry'; HortScience 1996 10.21273/hortsci.31.7.1190 'Benzyladenine and Gibberellic Acid Increase Runner Production in Dayneutral Strawberries') are title_only (no abstract read). Screened-out strawberry PMIDs: 38905729 (Cd stress, no GA3 application), 38498457 (Hydrangea paniculata 'Vanilla Strawberry' - NOT Fragaria, excluded), 36200851 (FveFDM1 methylation, tangential).

toxicity_window.notes: No ED50/TD50/therapeutic-index data in any retrieved abstract. GA3 is a plant growth regulator (not a pesticide); PubMed hits do not include toxicological dose-response studies for plants. The only risk-related claim (200 mg/L + long photoperiod -> flower abortion/malformed fruits) is unverified.

conflicts: CSV Target_Crops='Strawberry, fruit crops' does not include tomato or cucumber, yet pilot requires 3 crops; tomato/cucumber evidence is provided as extension, not CSV validation (status found_verified for mechanism/effect; CSV dosing claims for these crops absent).

CSV mechanism 'cell elongation/flowering': cell elongation verified in cucumber hypocotyls (37201922) and tomato growth trials; 'flowering' mechanism verified only indirectly (floral initiation reviews 40853749; strawberry flowering-runnering trade-off 38337908); CSV strawberry claims are about runner/vegetative responses, which are confirmed.

CSV '100 mg/L best for vegetative results' - closest corroboration is tomato (41225064: 25-75 mg/L foliar yield trial; 40866815: 100 mg/L priming under stress). No strawberry-specific 100 mg/L confirmation found.
Cucumber parthenocarpy dosage evidence uses GA4+7 (29146357), not GA3; not substitutable for GA3 dose claims.
CSV '0.5 mM GA3 in 0.053 M citric buffer pH 4.5 with 2% DMSO applied to whole fruit' and '1.0 mM weekly -> ~13 runners' could not be traced to any indexed publication; flagged inferred/unverified.
Europe PMC unavailable (network block) - PubMed + OpenAlex used instead; an independent Europe PMC re-run by orchestrator is recommended.

verdict.reason: Core CSV claims for strawberry (GA3 promotes vegetative growth and runner production; gibberellin class; CAS/formula correct) are VERIFIED by 4 read abstracts (40780106, 29288326, 33890635, 38337908). Tomato and cucumber extensions verified for growth/parthenocarpy effects. However, all CSV-specific dosage numbers (25-200 ppm, 100 mg/L optimum, 1.0 mM weekly ~13 runners/plant, 200 mg/L + long photoperiod -> flower abortion/malformed fruits, 0.5 mM citric-buffer/DMSO fruit application) are UNVERIFIED - no PubMed/OpenAlex source found; efficacy 'MEDIUM' neither confirmed nor refuted by dose-response data. Target_Crops mismatch (tomato, cucumber not listed) requires editorial decision. Recommended: mark entry 'partial', keep verified mechanism claims, flag dosage claims as inferred with source='CSV', and re-run Europe PMC + grey-literature (horticultural journals not indexed in PubMed) for the dosage claims.
